# Research Contribution

## Contribution

Describe the research question or evidence correction and the resulting change.

## Primary sources and verification

List source versions and method/experiment locators. State which results are author-reported, independently reproduced, or proposed. Explain any unresolved metadata or access gaps.

## Checks

- [ ] Repository content is professional academic English.
- [ ] Citations, venue claims, numerical conditions, and code relationships are checked.
- [ ] No credentials, private data, raw paper collections, or unapproved artifacts are included.
- [ ] Markdown passes `npm run lint`, and local links resolve.
- [ ] Paper index, machine-readable catalog, bibliography, and affected synthesis documents are consistent.
